Package com.bupt.ta.servlet

Class BaseServlet

java.lang.Object
javax.servlet.GenericServlet
javax.servlet.http.HttpServlet
com.bupt.ta.servlet.BaseServlet
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, javax.servlet.Servlet, javax.servlet.ServletConfig
Direct Known Subclasses:
AdminApplicationsByStatusServlet, AdminApplicationServlet, AdminCvServlet, AdminExportServlet, AdminJobServlet, AdminJobViewServlet, AdminServlet, AdminTaProfilesServlet, AdminUserServlet, AiDemoServlet, AiStreamServlet, ApplicationServlet, CvDownloadServlet, ForgotPasswordServlet, JobServlet, LoginServlet, LogoutServlet, MoApplicantProfileServlet, MoServlet, ProfileServlet, RegisterServlet, ResetPasswordServlet
public abstract class BaseServlet extends javax.servlet.http.HttpServlet
Abstract base class for all application servlets.

Provides shared session helpers and role-based access guards used by admin and MO endpoints. Concrete servlets extend this class and declare their own @WebServlet mappings or web.xml entries.

Not mapped to a URL directly; subclasses supply URL patterns and authorization rules.

    • ensureAdmin

      protected boolean ensureAdmin(javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest req, javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse resp) throws IOException
      Ensures the caller is authenticated and has the Roles.ADMIN role.

      Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login. Authenticated non-admins receive HTTP 403 Forbidden.

      Parameters:
      req - the incoming request
      resp - the response used for redirect or error
      Returns:
      true if the caller is an admin and may continue; false if the response has already been committed (redirect or 403)
      Throws:
      IOException - if sending the redirect or error fails
